mainText: Hello, Verona! At 11 AM, here is today's balanced dish: we have a temperature of 74 degrees with light drizzle falling over at Reddan Soccer Park, all under a Waning Gibbous moon phase.

City residents should note two important updates: road surface treatments are scheduled for August 4th through the 7th starting on Lincoln Street, and the city continues to offer rebates for both high-efficiency toilets and rain barrels to support conservation efforts.
There is plenty to do with live music at Bailey's Run Vineyard today, and tomorrow brings the Remote Area Medical clinic at the high school as well as the Sugar River Paddle and Jamboree.
A noteworthy call from the police department occurred on July 26, when an officer responded to a hit-and-run crash near West Verona Avenue and Epic Lane involving an 83-year-old driver.
Today's delicious flavor is Raspberry Cheesecake. You can also find the Kona Ice truck at Fireman's Park today from 12:30 PM to 4:30 PM, and the store remains open until 10:30 PM tonight.
